data.content:
The component tokens explicitly specify:

- `--instui-component-alert-color: var(--instui-color-text-base)`
- `--instui-component-alert-icon-color: var(--instui-color-icon-on-color)`

So the current light-mode behavior is intentional according to the token contract: dark body text and white icon glyphs. The `*-background` tokens are solid status colors; the `*-background-inline` tokens are pastel surfaces intended for an inline treatment.

Changing all Alert text to `on-color` would depart from that contract and make light-mode warning text white on gold, which is low contrast.
